title: ONLY Apply on the Company Website 🔎
description:
We always reccomend applying to jobs directly through a company’s site compared to something like LinkedIn, but why? The first reason is a company may have an ATS on their site that they don’t have on LinkedIn, but also a hiring manager is often going to look at applicantions through their site first before looking at a third party board. #jobapplication #jobapplications #jobapplicationtips
